document.abstract: Many people see engineering and tech as fields devoted to innovation and problem-solving. Media technology and engineering shatter this idea by viewing innovation as a means of telling or enhancing stories. No one encapsulates this more than Philip Courtney, the Director of Solutions Design at Electrosonic. He has spent his career in the worlds of AV, broadcast, and immersive experience design.
